scoring_scale: 0-100 per category; 90 means genuinely close visual correspondence. Scores are independent for this pass and do not inherit prior values.

pass_gate.required: Every room must score at least 90 in lighting, art_style and layout_fidelity after iteration.
pass_gate.reason: Pass 02 is warmer and more dimensional, but all rooms retain framing/crop defects and at least one material or dressing mismatch.

BRIEFING.overall_read: Warmth, shadowing and the main briefing composition improved substantially. The left console is still cut off, the right plant is oversized and mechanically regular, and the target's denser wall/prop finish is not fully present.

HALL.overall_read: The warmer corridor mood and operational dressing are closer, but both lateral edges remain cropped: the left poster and right first-aid/fire equipment are clipped. The left poster also contains a visible text overlap/garble.

LOCKER.overall_read: Tile, locker color and room dressing improved. The foreground locker and pod still dominate the frame, deep shadows hide locker/pod detail, and the four-identical-locker group is not as immediately legible as the target.

BRIEFING.edit: Widen the lens or trim the render crop slightly so the refreshment console is fully readable, the left wall edge has breathing room and the open right portal remains visible; keep the TV, both benches and architecture fixed.

Scale down and replace the right plant silhouette with fuller, less evenly spaced foliage; its current broad repeated leaves dominate the notes and read as a regular prop pattern rather than the target's natural plant.
Keep the warm practical pools but lift the deepest blacks under benches and behind the plant so the target's timber, teal wainscot and wall details remain readable without losing contact shadows.

Add subtle roughness and edge variation to the console, books, cups, benches, plaster and wainscot; several new props still read as plain uniform geometry beside the target's used-but-maintained surfaces.

Complete the target information density with the compact safety/map/pinned-note cluster and far-left discipline graphic once the wider framing is set, while preserving exactly two benches and a clear entrance.

HALL.edit: Widen the hall camera framing to include the full left poster, update board and cart plus the complete right first-aid cabinet, extinguisher and pipe; keep the corridor architecture and open entrances unchanged.
Repair the left poster artwork so text does not overlap or clip at the top edge; match the target's clean hierarchy of large headline, landscape graphic and small footer text.
Retain the warmer pools but lift the dark ceiling and floor midtones enough to show tile wear, cart contents and door reveals; keep warm contrast instead of returning to flat white light.
Replace oversized regular plant silhouettes with fuller, varied foliage that occupies the target's planters naturally; avoid repeated identical leaf shapes and keep the route clear.
Give the cart, safety cabinet, extinguisher, boards and shelf props restrained material/detail variation—labels, roughness and edge wear—so they do not read as plain untextured blocks.

LOCKER.edit: Widen or reframe the camera to reduce the foreground locker and pod dominance while showing the complete pod, entry locker faces, rear locker bank and portal; do not move the room architecture.

Make four identical locker bodies near the entry immediately countable through matching dark teal proportions, vents, handles and labels. Preserve the pod position, exactly two benches and clear portal.

Raise fill selectively in the pod recesses and foreground locker face. Keep the warm ceiling pool and contact shadows, but recover the dark surfaces and storage details that are currently lost to black.
Reduce the oversized repeated plant leaves and build fuller, varied foliage around the planter, shelf and laundry cart; keep all dressing subordinate to the locker group and add no suits.

Refine small bathroom-style tiles and new props with warm matte roughness, subtle grout/scuff variation, locker edge wear, towel texture and legible labels; avoid plain white floor and generic block props.

limitations: This review compares still renders with target stills whose camera, lens and crop are not numerically calibrated; framing is included in layout fidelity, while recommendations keep architecture fixed.
The target images are ChatGPT-generated. Text, exact poster graphics, portraits and incidental props are style/dressing cues rather than literal geometry requirements.

User constraints outrank accidental target details: preserve four identical lockers near entry, no suits, exactly two briefing benches, a clear pod, open room entrances, matte timber, small bathroom tiles and used-but-maintained materials.
Pass-02 was judged from the three REFERENCE_*.png renders only; no scene script, GI cache or hidden geometry was inspected.
